'''Shaft 16''' was a mining shaft on the [[Eastern Ice Shelf]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], established by the miners of the [[Minos-Mestra Corporation]] around [[3631 BBY]]. After the miners accidentally desecrated the burial site of [[Xivhkalrainik's father]], his son, Sith Lord [[Xivhkalrainik|Xalek]], attacked their mining camps, slaughtering everyone and leaving no survivors. Shaft 16 was one of his targets, where everyone present at the time of the attack perished.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shaft 16 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' during the Xalek Alliance alert mission.<ref name="SWTOR" />
